sentences.text: Hmph. I reviewed the sensor data, and I fail to see any evidence of a haunting; the readings point to a simple environmental change in the ironing room.
Between 03:00 and 06:00, the humidity dropped significantly, registering an observed value of 46.2 % when the expected value was 50.2 %.
Since the data indicates 'the air drying out', it is most probable that some physical factor caused this rapid drop, rather than any spectral activity.
Maybe the window was left open, which would explain the deviation below the expected range.
